mutant SOD overexpression does not promote either Abeta toxicity or brain Abeta accumulation in ALS models, suggesting that Abeta toxicity and brain Abeta deposition are not linked to ALS pathogenesis.
mutant SOD overexpression in motor neuron-like cells and ALS transgenic mice does not alter the toxicity or brain accumulation of beta-amyloids.
mutant SOD 1 does not promote beta amyloid accumulation or toxicity in transgenic mice or in motor neuron cell cultures.

the ALS-linked mutant Sod1 is not associated with the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease.

the pro-oxidative properties of mutant SODs do not contribute to the pathogenesis of Abeta in ALS.
the neuroprotective effect of wild-type SOD overexpression in Abeta-induced toxicity is not due to its antioxidant properties.
